rows.recommendation: Build more water-harvesting and conservation structures to catch rain (>1000 mm/yr), especially in hard-rock terrain; use the CGWB Master Plan for Artificial Recharge
Restore and rejuvenate all existing tanks to capture surface runoff for artificial recharge, with periodic maintenance (CGWB Manual on Artificial Recharge Techniques)
Use NAQUIM aquifer-mapping reports and the Ground Water Year Book (water level and quality) for local groundwater management
Expand micro-irrigation: irrigation uses about 89% of groundwater, so efficiency gains cut the largest load
Run mass-awareness campaigns, farmer/public outreach, display boards, water-management training, and school painting/essay activities
In urban and industrial areas, treat and safely dispose of industrial effluents, solid waste and sewage so the shallow (phreatic) aquifer is not polluted
Enforce the Ministry of Jal Shakti groundwater-extraction guidelines notified 24.09.2020 and amended March 2023

Plan by aquifer group (BGC, Basalt, Schists, Granites, Charnockites, Limestones, Laterites, Sandstones, Alluvium): hard-rock groups need fracture-focused recharge; alluvium is a narrow coastal/stream belt

validation.note: All rows are proposed guidance (proposed_not_observed); none is an observed outcome. The irrigation 89% share is the only quantified lever (Q-033).
